<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace __MODULE__\Presentation\Api\Provider\__AREA__;

use ApiPlatform\Metadata\Operation;
use ApiPlatform\State\Pagination\TraversablePaginator;
use ApiPlatform\State\ProviderInterface;
use ArrayIterator;
use Auth\Infrastructure\Security\User\SecurityUser;
use __MODULE__\Application\UseCase\Query\__AREA__\__USE_CASE__\{__ITEM_RESULT_CLASS__, __QUERY_CLASS__};
use __MODULE__\Presentation\Api\Dto\Output\__AREA__\__OUTPUT_CLASS__;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use Shared\Application\Contract\Pagination\{PaginatedResult, Pagination};
use Shared\Application\Exception\MessengerRuntimeException;
use Shared\Application\Port\Inbound\QueryBusPort;
use Symfony\Bundle\SecurityBundle\Security;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\RequestStack;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\{AccessDeniedHttpException, BadRequestHttpException};

use function is_numeric;
use function is_string;
use function max;

/**
 * Provider __PROVIDER_CLASS__.
 *
 * @category Provider
 *
 * @version 1.0.0
 *
 * @author __AUTHOR__
 *
 * @implements ProviderInterface<__OUTPUT_CLASS__>
 */
final readonly class __PROVIDER_CLASS__ implements ProviderInterface
{
  // #region Constructor
  public function __construct(
    private QueryBusPort $queryBus,
    private __AUTHORIZATION_PORT__ $authorization,
    private Security $security,
    private RequestStack $requestStack,
  ) {
  }
  // #endregion

  // #region Methods
  /**
   * Method provide.
   *
   * @since 1.0.0
   *
   * @return TraversablePaginator<__OUTPUT_CLASS__>
   */
  public function provide(Operation $operation, array $uriVariables = [], array $context = []): object
  {
    $user = $this->security->getUser();
    if (!$user instanceof SecurityUser) {
      throw new AccessDeniedHttpException('Authentication required.');
    }

    $scopeId = $uriVariables['__SCOPE_ID__'] ?? null;
    if (!is_string($scopeId) || '' === $scopeId) {
      throw new BadRequestHttpException('__SCOPE_ID__ URI parameter is required.');
    }

    if (!$this->authorization->__AUTHORIZATION_METHOD__($user->getId(), $scopeId, '__PERMISSION__')) {
      throw new AccessDeniedHttpException('Missing __PERMISSION__ permission.');
    }

    $request = $this->requestStack->getCurrentRequest();
    $__FILTER_ONE_PROPERTY__ = $request?->query->get('__FILTER_ONE_QUERY_PARAM__');
    $__FILTER_TWO_PROPERTY__ = $request?->query->get('__FILTER_TWO_QUERY_PARAM__');

    $filters = $context['filters'] ?? [];
    /** @var array<string, mixed> $filters */
    $pageValue = $filters['page'] ?? 1;
    $itemsPerPageValue = $filters['itemsPerPage'] ?? 30;

    $page = is_numeric($pageValue) ? (int) $pageValue : 1;
    $itemsPerPage = is_numeric($itemsPerPageValue) ? (int) $itemsPerPageValue : 30;

    $page = max(1, $page);
    $itemsPerPage = max(1, $itemsPerPage);

    $offset = ($page - 1) * $itemsPerPage;

    try {
      /** @var PaginatedResult<__ITEM_RESULT_CLASS__> $result */
      $result = $this->queryBus->ask(new __QUERY_CLASS__(
        __SCOPE_ID__: $scopeId,
        __FILTER_ONE_PROPERTY__: is_string($__FILTER_ONE_PROPERTY__) && '' !== $__FILTER_ONE_PROPERTY__ ? $__FILTER_ONE_PROPERTY__ : null,
        __FILTER_TWO_PROPERTY__: is_string($__FILTER_TWO_PROPERTY__) && '' !== $__FILTER_TWO_PROPERTY__ ? $__FILTER_TWO_PROPERTY__ : null,
        pagination: new Pagination(offset: $offset, limit: $itemsPerPage),
      ));
    } catch (InvalidArgumentException $exception) {
      throw new BadRequestHttpException($exception->getMessage(), $exception);
    } catch (MessengerRuntimeException $exception) {
      throw $exception;
    }

    $outputs = [];
    foreach ($result->items as $item) {
      $outputs[] = $this->mapResult($item);
    }

    return new TraversablePaginator(
      traversable: new ArrayIterator($outputs),
      currentPage: (float) $page,
      itemsPerPage: (float) $itemsPerPage,
      totalItems: (float) $result->total,
    );
  }

  /**
   * Method mapResult.
   *
   * @since 1.0.0
   */
  private function mapResult(__ITEM_RESULT_CLASS__ $result): __OUTPUT_CLASS__
  {
    $output = new __OUTPUT_CLASS__();
    __OUTPUT_ASSIGNMENTS__

    return $output;
  }
  // #endregion
}
